title: Potato and Mild Pepper Curry
description: A French-inspired twist on traditional Indian curries, featuring mildly spiced potatoes and peppers.
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the curry powder and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced potatoes and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the mild pepper. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
